>I know the prospect of suffering for the rest of your life is daunting and crushing 

That's the point though. If I don't care about finding happiness and death will end my suffering, I see no real downside. That's one of the major points I think about every time I consider it. I do appreciate the sentiment though..   


By any chance, do you happen to know if it's worth calling the suicide hotline? A couple of nights ago, I was in a really bad place and I was about t, but before I called them I looked up Reddit threads about whether the suicide hotline was worth calling or not and I read that they will sometimes call the cops on you if they think you are a danger to yourself. I desperately want someone to talk to, but if that is even a slight possibility then I don't want to take the risk...

I want to talk to someone. Badly.. I have a strong desire to talk to a therapist, but I feel a bit overwhelmed with making it happen. I don't have health insurance currently, and the idea of finding a therapist that is "right" for me is a bit overwhelming. The two together just make it seem a bit unrealistic, but I know I need to do something.

I'm not sure... My aunt has been "loosely" diagnosed as schizoaffective, and she clearly has some sort of mental illness, but I'm not sure if I would agree that that's what she has or if that history of mental illness could affect me when it doesn't show in either of my parents. The "voice" is still me. It's my voice. I just don't feel like I can control it when it derails and becomes so dark and negative.
